findings.title: Audit turnaround (39.5s) initially looked prompt-only; corroborated as live tool-driven verification
findings.body: Auditor left AGY_LIVE_PROBE_SCRIPT.py (this directory) behind at the worktree root after its --add-dir run: independently-authored Python that imports the live FORBIDDEN_PATHS list and drives both consumer call shapes against newline/CR/tab, exact-exemption-spoof, traversal+newline, near-miss+control-char, all 11 intended exemptions, and ordinary paths. Implementer re-ran it post-hoc: ALL TESTS PASSED (6/6 sub-cases). See AUDITOR_REPORT.md.

fixes_applied: Added leading FORBIDDEN_PATHS entry re.compile(r".*[\x00-\x1f\x7f]", re.DOTALL) in src/dopemux/dcp/red_lane_rules.py to fail-closed on any embedded/trailing control character, independent of downstream carve-out pattern correctness.
